secrets.name: VITE_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID
secrets.description: EmailJS service ID for the contact form. Optional at boot; contact form email sending won't work without it.

secrets.name: VITE_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID
secrets.description: EmailJS template ID for the contact form. Optional at boot; contact form email sending won't work without it.

secrets.name: VITE_EMAILJS_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: EmailJS public key for the contact form. Optional at boot; contact form email sending won't work without it.
